instruction: Remove the account "anonym-x2024@outlook.com" and add a new account with the same email address using POP3 protocol instead of IMAP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the protocol for an existing account from IMAP to POP3. Evaluator uses existing check_csv metric to verify the account now uses POP3 protocol (pop://) and no longer uses IMAP protocol (imap://). No custom functions needed - reuses existing check_csv from general.py.

Complete coverage: Both removal of IMAP and addition of POP3 are verified through expect/unexpect rules
